limits.legal_product_cap_applies_to: whether a device is a plug-in microgenerator under SI 2026/848
limits.note: Two different caps apply and they are often confused. 800 W is the product cap set by SI 2026/848 for something to count as a plug-in microgenerator. 3.68 kW per phase is the connection-process cap for Engineering Recommendation G98. They serve different purposes.

legislation_summary.note: Regulation 3 of SI 2026/848 extends to England and Wales and Scotland. All licence areas in this file are within that extent.
